track: native Ubuntu 22.04 (verified inside the WSL2 distro, same userland as a native install)

dependencies_reference.source: scripts/install_deps_ubuntu2204.sh --check (dpkg versions on the verified host)

smoke_replay.command: FASTLIVO2_WS=$HOME/xplat_ws python3 scripts/run_ros2_bag.py $HOME/repro/datasets/hilti_exp14_ros2 xplat_ubuntu_smoke_02 --rate 0.5 --dataset HILTI22 --output-root results/runs
smoke_replay.note: fresh-workspace smoke run at 0.5x; archived 0.5x Exp14 runs scored 3.57/3.73 cm, so this is the same order. Purpose is build+runner validation, not a new accuracy claim.

issue_found_and_fixed.symptom: first smoke run (xplat_ubuntu_smoke_01) produced no trajectory; algorithm.log showed "open fail" every frame
issue_found_and_fixed.cause: build_ros2_workspace.sh initially excluded src/FAST-LIVO2/Log/result, the directory the estimator writes its TUM output into
issue_found_and_fixed.fix: the script now keeps the directory (and Log/pcd), removes only the third-party ntu_viral ground truth that ships with the upstream port, and .gitignore keeps the empty dirs via .gitkeep

not_yet_verified: a real non-WSL Ubuntu 22.04 install (same userland, but USB/network/systemd paths differ)
ARM/aarch64 builds (the code has an aarch64 branch; we have not run it)
hardware drivers (Mid-360, D455) and PX4 integration - see docs/04

ros1_container_smoke.purpose: after the cross-platform refactor, prove the ROS1 runner still resolves its container paths (/work, /datasets) via scripts/site_config.py
ros1_container_smoke.command: docker exec fastlivo2-ros1 bash -lc "... python3 /work/scripts/run_ros1_bag.py /datasets/hilti_exp14_3topics.bag xplat_ubuntu_smoke_ros1_01 --rate 0.5 --dataset HILTI22"
ros1_container_smoke.note: 0.5x Exp14; archived 0.5x ROS1 value was 3.57 cm
